Convert a fitted transition tree to a data frame of contexts

Source: R/context_tree.R
as.data.frame.transitiontrees.Rd

as.data.frame() returns the contexts of a fitted tree as a table with one row per context, the same table that tree_pathways() returns. Each row gives the context, its depth and count, the most likely next state and its probability, and how much the context's prediction departs from that of its shorter suffix.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'transitiontrees'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

x

A transitiontrees object.

row.names, optional

Not used.

...

Passed to tree_pathways(): min_count, sort_by and decreasing.

Value

A data.frame with one row per context and columns pathway, depth, count, likely_next, next_probability, divergence and changes_prediction, described in tree_pathways().

See also

tree_pathways(), common_pathways(), divergent_pathways(), tree_dependence().

Examples

tree <- context_tree(trajectories, max_depth = 2)
as.data.frame(tree)
#>                     pathway depth count likely_next next_probability divergence
